title: v-once clashes with v-if

labels.name: has PR
labels.description: A pull request has already been submitted to solve the issue

body:
### Version
3.0.0-rc.9

### Reproduction link
[https://github.com/luka-mikec/vue-once-if-issue-demo](https://github.com/luka-mikec/vue-once-if-issue-demo)







### Steps to reproduce
1. Create a new Vue 3 project (through vue-cli or vite)
2. Replace App.vue with: https://github.com/luka-mikec/vue-once-if-issue-demo/blob/master/src/App.vue
3. Run `npm run serve` (or `npm run dev` with Vite) and try loading the app in a browser

### What is expected?
The resulting webpage should display "a"

### What is actually happening?
